ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational skills.

2. When practising Public Presentation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
